lead: Spacecraft have landed gently on the Moon 28 times since 1966, and many more have crashed. This page puts every landing on one Moon you can turn with your finger, including the far side we never see from Earth.
try: Press Far side and tap the dot for Chang'e 4. Then press South pole, and under Measure the Moon press Chandrayaan-3 → Chang'e 6.
points: Only five countries have landed softly on the Moon: the Soviet Union, the USA, China, India and Japan. Twelve astronauts walked there between 1969 and 1972.
China's Chang'e 4 made the first far-side landing in 2019. In 2024 Chang'e 6 brought the first far-side rocks home.
Everyone is now heading for the south pole, because deep craters there that never see sunlight hold water ice. India's Chandrayaan-3 landed closer to it in 2023 than anyone before.
